## Modules

Please review the Pawsey [Modules page](https://pawsey.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/US/pages/51925906/Modules) for more details. 

On Pawsey, modules should be loaded with their full version, eg `module load spack/0.23.1`.

Pawsey has numerous tools installed globally as [`modules`](https://pawsey.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/US/pages/51925906/Modules). USyd users may be well acquainted with `module` commands from their use of Artemis and/or NCI Gadi HPC. Please review the Pawsey [Modules page] for more details. 


## Install tools with Spack 

https://pawsey.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/US/pages/51925886/Spack

module load spack/0.23.1

Tools not globally available can be self-installed into `/software/projects/$PAWSEY_PROJECT/`
